BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Baratok!!
My gosh?! What's this?!
What the hey is this thing?! It's shattered...
Aye, it's a "Star Chart"!
A Star Chart~?
It's an incredible weapon made by the old man and\nhis sister. Once finished, it might be able to\nwipe out Coenubia. That's what he used to say...
That's amazing! But they couldn't finish it?!
Aye...Just when they were about to finish it,\nCoenubia found out it was dangerous...
I see. So these traces of battle were from the\nclash with the invading Coenubias.
Information about the "Star Chart" was all in the\nold man's head...He killed himself so that\nCoenubia wouldn't be able to peer into his mind.
Now nobody can make it.
I don't know if he was a scientist or a magus,\nbut he must've been a great man.
Aye! Now I remember! My friends and I fought very\nhard to protect the old man too! We didn't let the\nCoenubias beat us!
What?! You fought?!
So it was you who fought here?!
Yeah! We trained and studied too here, determined\nto do our best and not let the Coenubias beat us\nuntil the Star Chart was finished!
Like an elite squad of Lixis against the\nCoenubias?
Turns out you've had a pretty rough past too~.
Aye! The best! I was the best and my friends kept\ntelling me how great I was!
They really looked up to you, didn't they~?\nThat's why you remember that part so fondly~.
But based on the condition of this place and the\nweapon debris, everyone was wiped out here, right?\nHow did you make it out after that?
Yeah, what happened?
I get that the old man killed himself.\nBut what about you and your friends...?
Hahaha, I won't be defeated...\nI'm his "right-hand", you know...
Hahaha, you think you can get away from\n"these ears"...?
Hahahaha...
Hahaha, ha...
My gosh! It's a Coenubia again!\nWhere did it even come from~?!
We accidentally let our guard down!\nC'mon, let's do this!
H-hey?! What's wrong?!
W-what happened?! Is Anono hurt?!
W-what do we do now?! He's unconscious!
Let's quickly carry him to the ark!
Let's let him rest for a while.
Y-yeah, you're right!\nHe can get some proper rest on the ark, and maybe\nReliza can prepare some medicine to treat him!
Let him rest where?\nThe bed on the first floor of this tower?
Of course not! The idea was to carry him to the\nark quickly!
Oh, I see. Got it!
Alright, I'm the strong one here. I'll carry him!
For now, his pulse seems fine.\nAlright, let's head to the ark!
Good to see you back, my "fingertip"...
Yeah, I remember everything now.\nWithout me even realizing it, at some point,\nit wasn't the old man anymore...
The one who was ordering me around...It was...\nand my friends were...
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back!
Explore this place a little longer!
